name: work-loop-stop-after-pause
title: work-loop stop and reconcile fail on a run whose lock was already released
description: pause releases the work-loop ownership lock by design, but stop and reconcile reached require_lock through mutate_state and demanded one back, so a paused run could not be stopped and the documented reconcile recovery route could not be walked. mutate_state now takes released_lock_statuses and those two commands pass it.
creator: sdelmas
